primary_reference.time_dtype: int64; never float64 for absolute nanoseconds

comparison_recommendation.window_aggregation: Same frozen 10 s nominal center +/-5 s: arithmetic mean of finite positive HR notifications in [center-5,center+5).
comparison_recommendation.reference_eligibility: Inside first-HR to last-HR + median interval, at least 2 values, no internal gap >2 s; do not extrapolate startup.
comparison_recommendation.shift_sign: Positive places video start later on reference UTC.
comparison_recommendation.waveform_reference: Use timestamped raw PPG only as an exploratory optical reference; no channel or lag optimization against rPPG; do not claim verified cross-site morphology recovery.

limitations: All recordings lack a shared camera trigger, video first-frame UTC or shared visible marker in supplied metadata; timing remains conditional.
Use Polar hr_bpm with integer host_utc_ns as HR reference. Its internal averaging and notification delay are unknown; do not label it ECG truth.

PPG is three raw optical channels plus ambient. Negative values are not alone evidence of invalidity. Device sample times are collector reconstructions; host arrival repeats once per packet and must not be treated as PPG sampling timestamps.
Missing HR device timestamps and RR values are expected unavailable fields; HR bpm itself is populated. No beat-level RR or annotation truth is provided.
No index gaps or recorded queue drops supports record continuity only, not independent physiological validity or proof of no device/transport loss.
Video duration must use decoded frame count and stream rational fps, not rounded avih microseconds. data4 avih and strh disagree by 9 frames.
Whole-video overlap and window computability do not establish physical synchronization; report all predeclared shifts rather than selecting the best error.
data1 repeats the previously analyzed source, so it is not new independent validation. Six clips do not imply six independent participants.

This audit reads ZIP directory, small references and the first 64 KiB of each AVI, without extracting/modifying originals or loading video payloads into memory. Full video CRC/decode validation is owned by the execution task.
